title: Shabbat — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Shabbat, the Sabbath from Friday sunset to Saturday night, is Judaism's weekly day of rest and worship. Traditional observance includes candle lighting, festive meals, and refraining from work. This overview edition presents Shabbat within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
